source: Transcribed from the Belle food and drink menu PDFs dated October 2025. Dietary marks follow the printed menus; anything unmarked, ask the team.
serviceNote: Tables of six or more have a discretionary 12.5% service charge added, shared equally among our hourly paid team. Got an allergy or a special dietary requirement? Tell your server before you order. Everything is subject to availability.

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.intro: Served every day until 11.30am. Then the all-day menu takes over.

items.name: All Day Breakfast
items.desc: 2 rashers of grilled bacon, 2 fried eggs, 1 grilled sausage, mushrooms, grilled tomato, baked beans, hash browns & toast. Served Monday to Friday until 5pm.

burgers.title: Belle Burgers
burgers.intro: Smashed beef burger, southern fried chicken breast or a crispy vegetable pattie in a warm brioche-style bun (ve), with homemade burger sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion & gherkin. Have it dressed, topless or naked, with fries or salad. Swap to sweet potato fries for £2.
burgers.dipping: Make it a dipping burger: add a mug of American cheese or delicious gravy, £4.95.
